end.summary:
Practised plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and animals that eat both.
Built food chains using arrows and explained the feeding links.
Read chains including grass → deer, mango leaf → caterpillar, and algae → larva → fish.
Animal-eater categories were introduced, but teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised “Who eats what” through examples and simple arrow food chains. Manav explained the links in several chains, including why deer eat grass and why fish eat larvae. The animal-eater groups were not yet fully explained in the teach-back. At home, ask Manav to sort a few animals into plant-eaters, meat-eaters, or both, then make one food chain with arrows.
